Deleted = the objects of the structure tree by role and reachability: seeds the catalog /StructTreeRoot value (read before removal, alias objects pass the role), every /Type StructTreeRoot|StructElem object, the /SE targets and the first element of every GoTo /SD; closure root /K /ParentTree (nodes, /Nums arrays, element arrays) /IDTree (nodes, /Names arrays) /ClassMap (map + attribute objects with /O) /RoleMap, element /K /A /Ref, content items /Type MCR|OBJR, and every element (/S name, /Type absent or StructElem) whose /P is a tree object; an object the tree names where an element belongs is taken only when element_like/content_item (a /Type MediaClip|Rendition is not). /Pg /Obj /Stm /AF not followed. claim.text: redact_and_save / redact_and_save_with / redact_and_save_opts with the default StructureTreePolicy::Strip: when at least one region is flattened, the saved file holds no /StructTreeRoot, /MarkInfo, /StructParents, /StructParent or /SE entry, no /SD in a GoTo action whose /S is the name GoTo, and none of the structure-tree objects the strip identifies by role and reachability (the catalog root and every /Type StructTreeRoot object, their /K /ParentTree /IDTree /ClassMap /RoleMap closure, every /Type StructElem object, the elements /SE and GoTo /SD name, elements whose /P is in the tree, attribute objects and MCR/OBJR content items) that the strip can reach, nor a /Type StructElem|StructTreeRoot dictionary written directly in another object; a dictionary is not removed for its shape alone (R26-S1: kept-page media renditions and clips stay; check_document still reads their shape and reports NOT PROVEN). RedactedOutput::losses is [AccessibilityTagsRemoved] when a structure tree or structure entry the saved file would otherwise have held was removed (not for /MarkInfo alone, R26-S4), and a tagged document can read region_flattened / region_cleared / is_proven. Content streams are unchanged (marked-content operators with /MCID stay). What the strip cannot reach (an element member of an object stream kept as a stream, an element an alias object keeps reachable) is reported by check_document (region_flattened false, NotProven::ResidualInRegion). StructureTreePolicy::KeepNotProven keeps the pre-D28 behaviour. A save with no region strips nothing.

notes.typed_loss_pattern: press has no prior typed-loss struct; RedactionLoss follows the crate's existing typed enum + code() pattern (NotProven::code, FlattenNote::as_str, FlattenCause::as_str) and is carried on RedactedOutput like xfa_removed / flattened notes; no receipt mechanism added
design_choices: strip only when a region is flattened (PLR-101 scope: the structure rules apply only then; a no-region save keeps tags)
/SE removed as a key (the outline item stays), elements removed as objects (references scrubbed), direct element dictionaries removed where they sit
neutralize_structure still runs after the strip (no tree left: 0 neutralized)

loss reported only when a structure tree or structure entry the saved file would hold was removed; /MarkInfo is removed but alone does not count (R26-S4, replaces the earlier '/MarkInfo alone counts as tags removed')
R26-S1: deletion by role/reachability, detection by shape (check_document unchanged); a kept-page multimedia object with the structure shape is kept and over-reported, never deleted
/SD removed only where the action's /S is the direct name GoTo (GoToR/GoToE /SD name a remote document's structure); its first-element target is collected with /S resolved
residuals_fail_closed: an element member of an object stream kept as a stream (R24 K1): not edited, reported by check_document
an element reachable through an alias object (top-level reference object): the alias is not a dictionary, the element stays reachable, reported by check_document
residuals_not_counted: PLR-103 remainder: a dictionary with /S and a text key but no /P and no /Type that neither the tree reaches, nor an /SE or GoTo /SD names, nor whose /P is in the tree, is neither stripped nor counted (unchanged boundary, structure_shape_is_read_from_the_parsed_dictionary)

an object the tree names where an element belongs but whose /Type is neither StructElem, MCR nor OBJR is not removed (R26-S1 guard); if it stays reachable elsewhere it is counted only when check_document's shape rule reads it
